Look at a missed question in the Chunks tab: is the fact sentence in a chunk without the name of its service?
A fee sentence with no service name matches every other fee sentence equally well. The chunk needs the first sentence of its paragraph too.
Paragraphs here are about 180 to 225 characters. A chunk that holds one whole paragraph keeps the name and the facts together.
Recursive splitting cuts on paragraphs first, so a chunk size a little above the longest paragraph gives one paragraph per chunk. Two paragraphs per chunk is over budget.
